# Galleria Borghese Collection

> > Digital collection catalog of the Galleria Borghese in Rome, featuring masterpieces by Caravaggio, Raphael, Bernini, Titian, and other Renaissance and Baroque masters.

The Galleria Borghese houses one of the world's most important art collections, assembled primarily by Cardinal Scipione Borghese in the 17th century under the patronage of Pope Paul V. This site documents the museum's extraordinary holdings of Italian Renaissance paintings, Baroque sculptures, and works commissioned through papal and cardinal patronage.
